title: Word: Copilot Chat edit mode creates and edits documents for users without a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly limits Copilot Chat's organisational data access to content supplied with a prompt and overlooks another documented control for unlicensed users' in-app Chat access. The roadmap facts and Integrated Apps navigation are accurate, but the sources disagree about whether that block also covers Teams.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans an Edit mode in Copilot Chat in Word.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent mode in Word enables conversational support to create, edit and refine document content from chat

Keep the advice to confirm Edit mode's scope. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-overview.
